emma: FYI partner (GCP Marketplace integrator) reported failed installs across multiple zones. They want a shared channel + runbook review. Can we agree on an escalation ladder and channel naming? @frank @gwen
frank: yes. propose channel pattern `#partner-warroom-<partner>-<sev>` e.g. #partner-warroom-gcp-p0. I'll create and invite SI contacts.
gwen: agreed on name. For P0: 5m ack SLA, SRE triage -> partner liaison -> eng-runtime -> hw/SI vendor. For P1: 15m ack.
emma: partner specifically asks about access to logs — we need S3/SFTP creds rotation plan and timeboxed access. Legal signed an NDA already.
matt: I'll handle temporary access. Rule: create time-limited signed URL (12h) and push artifact link to channel. No persistent creds.
frank: adding runbook snippet in channel: ```1) Triage: check marketplace-proxy, adm-agent, installer logs
2) Commands: `kubectl -n marketplace get pods`, `kubectl -n marketplace logs installer -f --tail=200`
3) Artifact collection: `tar czf /tmp/inst-logs.tgz /var/log/installer /var/log/marketplace`
4) Upload: `scp /tmp/inst-logs.tgz partner@uploads.redwood:/incoming/SEV-200`
5) If install failures tied to HW (firmware mismatch) open hw-ticket to Atlas with tag `partner-install-firmware`
```
gwen: escalation contacts: SRE pager -> `#eng-oncall` -> partner liaison (partnerships) -> SI lead -> Atlas HW ops. Use external bridge if SI needs vendor channel.
emma: also flag marketing/comm if outage impacts partner launch announcement. We should have single comm owner.
matt: comm owner = emma. I'll draft short post for #partner-updates once we have impact list.
frank: one more: shared channel access levels: partners read/write, SI read-only unless explicitly invited, eng runtime full. Keep ops-bot in channel for automated incident updates.
hq-bot: Incident created: SEV-200 (partner-install-failure) by emma. War room: https://zoom.redwood/warroom/SEV-200
emma: ok I'm spinning up #partner-warroom-gcp-p0, inviting @frank @gwen @matt and partner handles. please ack in-channel when you join.
frank: ack. I'm in #partner-warroom-gcp-p0 :white_check_mark:
gwen: ack. joining now.
emma: quick checklist for postmortem owners: partnerships (impact + partner comms), eng-runtime (root cause), SRE (mitigation), hw (if hardware contributory). Schedule within 72h.
matt: noted. I'll create calendar invite and draft scope.
hq-bot: @channel SEV-200 triage started. Next automated update in 10m.
